Synopsis:
Indian equity markets (Nifty 50, BSE Sensex) extended losses near six-week lows, pressured by rising crude oil prices driven by escalating US-Iran tensions. Iran threatened retaliation on US assets and warned Gulf energy infrastructure is vulnerable. Brent crude rose to ~$98/bbl, a headwind for India given its ~85% crude import dependency. Financials led sector declines. Defence stocks outperformed on a domestic acquisition approval. IPO activity remains robust despite weak secondary market sentiment.
